hero.description: PeleCanon Atelier crafts bespoke architectural living spaces, custom kitchens, dressing rooms, and refined interior millwork with uncompromising European standards and artisanal precision.

philosophy.title: The Art of Purposeful Living
philosophy.quote: True luxury is not merely ornamentation; it is the silent harmony between architectural proportions, genuine natural textures, and everyday functional grace.
philosophy.p1: At PeleCanon Atelier, we treat interior millwork and furniture as lasting architectural extensions of your living space. Each creation begins with an in-depth spatial study, harmonizing human ergonomics with noble woods, tactile finishes, and concealed engineering.
philosophy.p2: From private villas to modern penthouses, our multidisciplinary team orchestrates every phase from blueprint sketching to final white-glove installation.
philosophy.pillar1Desc: Master joiners working with calibrated precision and enduring European joinery techniques.
philosophy.pillar2Desc: Clean geometric volumes calibrated precisely to your home's unique light and spatial rhythm.
philosophy.pillar3Desc: Kiln-dried hardwoods, premium European veneers, and anti-fingerprint architectural laminates.
philosophy.pillar4Desc: Every dimension, interior accessory, and concealed mechanism tailored to your exact lifestyle.

solutions.title: Refined Solutions for Distinctive Homes
solutions.subtitle: Explore our specialized fabrication divisions, engineered with seamless hardware integration and bespoke finishes.
solutions.kitchenDesc: Ergonomic culinary sanctuaries featuring concealed Blum motion hardware, integrated stone worktops, moisture-resistant carcases, and acoustic soft-close dampening.
solutions.dressingDesc: Custom walk-in wardrobes with warm perimeter ambient illumination, smoked glass vitrines, bespoke drawer organizers, and tailored jewelry trays.
solutions.doorsDesc: Floor-to-ceiling flush-mounted pivot doors, sound-attenuating solid timber cores, concealed magnetic latches, and harmonized natural veneers.
solutions.millworkDesc: Architectural wall paneling, floating media consoles with hidden cable channels, library bookcases, and tailored credenzas crafted to exact millimetric plans.

process.title: From Vision to Installed Perfection
process.subtitle: A transparent 5-step journey ensuring absolute fidelity to your architectural vision, budget, and timeline.
process.step1Desc: We meet at your residence or our atelier to analyze floor plans, functional needs, lighting conditions, and material preferences.
process.step2Desc: 3D elevation models, joinery cut-lists, and a transparent itemized quotation detailing every component, hardware spec, and veneer code.
process.step3Desc: Review tangible physical wood samples, lacquer swatches, and hardware prototypes in your home's natural light before signing.
process.step4Desc: Artisanal joinery, automated precision cutting, hand-finishing, and multi-point QC inspection in our controlled workshop.
process.step5Desc: Punctual delivery, professional dust-controlled installation by master fitters, final hardware calibration, and warranty handover.

craftsmanship.title: Crafted for Generations to Come
craftsmanship.subtitle: We reject temporary construction shortcuts. Every PeleCanon piece is built with enduring structural integrity and sustainable European timber.
craftsmanship.card1Desc: Kiln-cured American Walnut, European Oak, Ash, and rare natural veneers carefully bookmatched for striking grain flow across every cabinet door.
craftsmanship.card2Desc: Dovetail joints, dowel reinforcement, and world-class concealed sliding systems rated for over 100,000 flawless open-close cycles.
craftsmanship.card3Desc: Ultra-matte anti-scratch polyurethanes, natural hardwax oils, and hand-rubbed lusters that protect the wood while preserving its warm tactile touch.

tracking.title: Follow Every Step of Your Commission
tracking.subtitle: Never wonder where your custom furniture stands. Our dedicated digital client portal allows you to follow real-time progress from timber cutting to white-glove delivery.
tracking.secureNote: Commissions are securely accessible via your unique customer order code.

cta.title: Ready to Transform Your Interior?
cta.subtitle: Our senior design consultants are available to review your architectural blueprints, share wood swatches, and calculate an itemized estimate.
cta.locationNote: Private consultations available on-site at your residence or in our atelier showroom.

footer.brandDesc: PeleCanon Atelier Prestige designs and fabricates bespoke architectural millwork, luxury kitchens, and fine furniture with uncompromising European standards.
footer.rights: All rights reserved. Fine Cabinetry & Architectural Interior Solutions.
